//: ST-M4: which parts of the program ROM app/gameWorker.js may read. Only DATA — no code: the game logic is transcribed to JavaScript, the tables are copied 1:1 and read at their original addresses (decision 2026-08-30: the browser gets tables, never a ROM image). Addresses and meanings come from sources/asm/stinger/notes/A-D.md; 'from' is inclusive, 'len' in bytes.
